name: Additional Monstorin Traits
body:
Aerisor Monstorin Racial Traits (12 RP)
Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Strength, +2 Constitution, –2 Intelligence: Aerisor monstorin are brutish and stubborn.
Size: Medium. An aerisor’s size gives no bonuses or penalties.
Speed: Normal. Aerisors have a base speed of 30 feet.
Fast Charge: Aerisors gain a +10 foot racial bonus to their speed when using the charge, run, or withdraw actions.
Senses: Darkvision. Aerisors gain darkvision out to 60 ft.
Type: Outsider. Aerisors are outsiders with the earth, fire, and native subtypes.
Flame Step: When it moves, an aerisor creates smoldering flames in the space it leaves. These flames last for 1 round and deal 1d4 points of fire damage to creatures passing over them.
Fire in the Blood: Aerisors gain fast healing 2 for 1 round anytime they take fire damage (whether or not this fire damage overcomes their fire resistance). They can heal up to 2 hit points per level per day with this ability, after which it ceases to function.
Fire Resistance: Aerisors gain fire resistance 5.
Languages: Common and Ignan. Aerisors with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Draconic, Dwarven, Giant, Gnome, Goblin, Orc, Terran, and Undercommon.
Ailuro Monstorin Racial Traits (9 RP)
Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Dexterity, +2 Wisdom, –2 Intelligence: Ailuro are quick and alert, but know little beyond what they must to survive.
Size: Small. Ailuros are Small creatures and gain a +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a –1 penalty to their CMB and CMD, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.
Senses: Darkvision. Ailuros gain darkvision out to 60 ft.
Speed: Slow. Ailuros have a base speed of 20 ft.
Type: Monstrous Humanoid. Ailuros are monstrous humanoids.
Languages: Common and Sylvan. Ailuros with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Celestial, Draconic, Elven, Gnoll, Gnome, Goblin, and Orc.
Tree Climber (Ex): Ailuros gain a climb speed of 20 ft. This also grants them a +8 racial bonus to climb checks.
Resistances (Ex): Ailuro monstorin gain cold and fire resistance 5 and Spell Resistance up to 11 + their character level.
Angerie Monstorin Racial Traits (13 RP)
Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Wisdom, +2 Charisma: Astral faerie monstorin are wise with a commanding presence.
Size: Medium. An astral faerie’s size gives no bonuses or penalties.
Speed: Normal. Astral faeries have a base speed of 30 feet.
Senses: Darkvision. Astral faeries gain darkvision out to 60 ft.
Type: Outsider. Astral faeries are outsiders with the angel, good, and native subtypes.
Damage Reduction (Ex): Astral faeries gain DR 5/magic.
Resistances (Ex): Astral faeries gain acid and electricity resistance 5 and a bonus to saving throws against petrification effects equal to their character level.
Languages: Common and Celestial. Astral faeries with a high intelligence can choose from: the following: Abyssal, Aklo, Aquan, Draconic, Ignan, Infernal, and Terran.
Aquario Monstorin Racial Traits (13 RP)
Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Constitution, +2 Charisma: Aquarios are tough, considerate monstorin.
Size: Medium. An aquario’s size gives no bonuses or penalties.
Speed: Slow. Aquarios have a base speed of 20 feet, but their speed is never modified by armor or encumbrance.
Type: Humanoid. Aquario are humanoids with the monstorin subtype.
Natural Armor: An aquario gains +1 natural armor. When using total defense, this bonus rises to +4.
Fog Cloud (Sp): An aquario can cast fog cloud once per day. Its caster level is equal to its character level.
Translucent: Because their skin tone naturally blends with the surrounding area, aquarios gain a +4 racial bonus to Stealth checks. They can also attempt to hide while being observed, but they must still have something to hide behind.
Languages: Common and Auran. Aquarios with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Aquan, Draconic, Elven, Gnome, Halfling, and Sylvan.
Armored Swine Monstorin Racial Traits (10 RP)
Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Constitution (suidae) or +2 Strength (wildesau), +2 Wisdom: Armored swine focus on different traits.
Size: Medium. An armored swine’s size gives no bonuses or penalties.
Speed: Armored swine have a base speed of 30 feet.
Senses: Low-Light Vision. Armored swine can see twice as far as humans in conditions of low light.
Type: Humanoid. Armored swine are humanoids with the monstorin subtype.
Gore: All armored swine gain a gore attack which deals 1d6 piercing damage on a hit. They also have powerful charge, which deals 2d6 + twice the swine’s Strength modifier.
Armored Culture: Armored swine usually become adventurers after they are given their first suit of scale mail. They also gain a +2 racial bonus on all Craft (arms and armor) checks.
Languages: Common. Armored swine with high Intelligence can choose from the following: Dwarven, Gnome, Goblin, and Orc.
Astral Stalker Monstorin Racial Traits (13 RP)
Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Strength, +2 Wisdom, –2 Charisma: Astral stalkers are attentive and physically intimidating, but they lack care for what they deem are lesser beings.
Size: Medium. An astral stalker’s size gives no bonuses or penalties.
Speed: Astral stalkers have a base speed of 30 feet.
Senses: Darkvision. Astral stalkers gain darkvision out to 60 feet.
Type: Outsider. Astral stalkers are outsiders with the native subtype.
Ageless: As the monster special ability presented here.
Dangerous Claws: Astral stalkers have 2 natural claw attacks that deal 1d6 piercing and slashing damage on a hit with a critical multiplier of x3.
Haste (Sp): An astral stalker can cast haste on itself as a spell?like ability once per day. Its caster level is its character level.
Intimidating Prowess: Astral stalkers begin play with Intimidating Prowess as a bonus feat.
Languages: Common and Infernal. Astral stalkers with high Intleligence scores can choose any language (except secret languages, such as druidic).
Behir Monstorin Racial Traits (11 RP)
Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Dexterity, +2 Wisdom, –2 Strength: Behir monstorin are quick and alert, but physically weak.
Size: Medium. A behir’s size gives no bonuses or penalties.
Speed: Fast. Even without their many legs, behirs are quick on their feet. They have a base speed of 40 feet.
Senses: Darkvision. Behirs gain darkvision out to 60 ft.
Senses: Low-Light Vision. Behirs can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.
Type: Monstrous Humanoid. Behirs are considered monstrous humanoids.
Lightning Breath (Su): Twice per day, as a standard action, behirs can make a breath weapon attack that deals 3d6 points of electricity damage in a 20 ft. line. All creatures within the affected area must make a Reflex saving throw to avoid taking damage. The save DC is 10 + 1/2 the behir’s character level + its Constitution modifier. Those who succeed take half damage from the attack.
Lightning Resistance (Ex): Behir monstorin gain electricity resistance 5.
Languages: Common and Draconic. Behirs with high Intelligence scores can choose any language (except secret languages, such as druidic).
Bovinae Monstorin Racial Traits (10 RP)
Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Strength, +2 Wisdom, –2 Dexterity: Bovinae monstorin are strong and attentive, but have an awkward gait.
Size: Medium. A bovinae’s size gives no bonuses or penalties.
Speed: Bovinaes have a base speed of 30 feet.
Improved Overrun (Ex): A bovinae gains Improved Overrun as a bonus feat, even if it does not meet the prerequisites.
Senses: Darkvision. Bovinaes gain darkvision out to 60 ft.
Senses: Low-Light Vision. Bovinaes can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.
Type: Monstrous Humanoid. Bovinaes are monstrous humanoids with the earth subtype.
Avalanche Stride: A bovinae that succeeds at an overrun always knocks the target prone if it isn’t immune to trip.
Break: A bovinae can add its Strength modifier on Disable Device checks in place of Dexterity. If it does and the check succeeds, the device is broken.
Languages: Common and Terran. Bovinaes with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, Halfling, and Orc.
Bulette Monstorin Racial Traits (11 RP)
Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Strength, +2 Wisdom, –2 Charisma: Bulette monstorin are physically strong, but can be short tempered.
Size: Medium. A bulette’s size gives no bonuses or penalties.
Speed: Bulettes have a base speed of 30 feet.
Burrow (Ex): Bulettes have a burrow speed of 20 feet.
Senses: Darkvision. Bulettes gain darkvision out to 60 ft.
Senses: Low-Light Vision. Bulettes can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.
Type: Monstrous Humanoid. Bulettes are monstrous humanoids.
Savage Bite (Ex): Bulettes have a natural bite attack that deals 1d8 bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage on a hit. When not wielding any weapons, the bulette adds 1-1/2 times its Strength modifier to its bite damage.
Jumper (Ex): Bulettes always count as having a running start when they jump.
Languages: Common and Undercommon. Bulettes with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Aklo, Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, and Terran.
Cactus Warrior Monstorin Racial Traits (9 RP)
Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Strength, +2 Wisdom, –2 Dexterity: Cactus warrior monstorin are strong and alert, but can be slow to react.
Size: Medium. A cactus warrior’s size gives no bonuses or penalties.
Speed: Slow. Cactus warriors have a base speed of 20 feet, but their speed is never modified by armor or encumbrance.
Senses: Darkvision. Cactus warriors gain darkvision out to 60 ft.
Senses: Low-Light Vision. Cactus warriors can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.
Type: Monstrous Humanoid. Cactus warriors are monstrous humanoids.
Energy Resistance: Cactus warriors gain fire resistance 5 and electricity resistance 5.
Immunities: Cactus Warriors are immune to magic sleep effects. They also gain a +2 racial saving throw bonus against enchantment spells and effects.
Needles: In light or no armor, a cactus warrior is always considered to have armor spikes. It is proficient in their use.
Languages: Common. Cactus warriors with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Dwarven, Ignan, Orc, Sylvan, and Terran.
Canceria Monstorin Racial Traits (12 RP)
Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Constitution, +2 Wisdom: Canceria monstorin are tough and insightful.
Size: Medium. A canceria’s size gives no bonuses or penalties.
Speed: Slow. Canceria have a base speed of 20 feet. They are never encumbered by armor or heavy loads.
Scuttle: A canceria can charge up to 60 feet in a round—in or out of water—and can do so without moving in a straight line.
Senses: Darkvision. Canceria gain darkvision out to 60 feet.
Type: Outsider. Canceria are outsiders with the water and native subtypes. Hold Breath: Canceria can hold their breath for a number of rounds equal to four times their Constitution score before risking drowning or suffocating.
Natural Armor: A canceria begins play with a +2 natural armor bonus.
Toughness: All canceria have Toughness as a bonus feat.
Languages: Common and Aquan. Canceria with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Draconic, Elven, Gnome, Goblin, Halfling, and Sylvan.
Capricor Monstorin Racial Traits
Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Strength, +2 Wisdom: Capricor monstorin are strong and alert, but rough around the edges.
Size: Medium. A capricor’s size gives no bonuses or penalties.
Speed: Capricors have a base speed of 30 feet.
Senses: Low-Light Vision. Capricors can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.
Type: Fey. Capricors are fey.
Fertile Soil: Capricor sorcerers with the verdant bloodline treat their Charisma score as 2 points higher for all sorcerer spells and class abilities. Capricor clerics with the Plant domain use their domain powers and spells at +1 caster level. This trait does not give capricors early access to level-based powers; it only affects powers that they could already use without this trait.
Treacherous Earth (Sp): Once per day, a capricor can will the earth to rumble and shift, transforming a 10-foot-radius patch of earth, unworked stone, or sand into an area of difficult terrain centered on a square it can touch. This lasts for a number of minutes equal to its character level, after which the ground returns to normal.
Languages: Common and Terran. Capricors with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Dwarven, Giant, Gnome, Goblin, Orc, and Undercommon.
Catirpel Monstorin Racial Traits (13 RP)
Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Strength, +2 Constitution: Catirpel monstorin are strong and tough with no immediate flaws. Female catirpel (lepitera monstorin) gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma instead.
Size: Medium. A catirpel’s size gives no bonuses or penalties.
Speed: Catirpels have a base speed of 30 feet.
Senses: Low-Light Vision. Catirpels can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.
Type: Humanoid. A catirpel is a humanoid with the monstorin subtype.
Multi-Armed: Catirpels have four arms and can wield multiple weapons. When doing so, only one of those weapons is considered primary. It can also use its hands for other purposes that require free hands.
Venomous: Catirpels gain the following extraordinary ability: A number of times per day equal to its Constitution modifier (minimum 1/day), a catirpel can envenom a weapon that it wields with its toxic saliva. Applying venom in this way is a swift action. Catirpel Venom—Injury; save Fort DC 10 + the 1/2 user’s Hit Dice + the user’s Constitution modifier; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d2 Dex; cure 1 save.
Languages: Common and Sylvan. Catirpels with high Intelligence scores can choose any language (except secret languages, such as druidic).
Fire Bird Racial Traits
Ability Score Modifiers: Fire birds are quick, smart, and brash. They gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, and –2 Wisdom.
Size: Fire birds are Medium creatures and thus receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
Type: Fire birds are outsiders with the fire and native subtypes.
Base Speed: Fire birds have a base speed of 30 feet.
Languages: Fire birds begin play speaking Common. Fire birds with high Intelligence scores can choose can choose any languages they want (except secret languages, such as Druidic). See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

Defense Racial Traits

Fire in the Blood: Fire birds gain fast healing 2 for 1 round anytime they take fire damage. They can heal up to 2 hit points per level per day.

Offense Racial Traits

Born in Flame: Fire birds are immune to light-based blindness and dazzle effects. They are treated as +1 level higher when casting light-based spells and spells with the fire descriptor or using light-based or fire-based class features. If a fire bird has an Intelligence score of 11 or higher, it also gains the following spell-like abilities (the caster level is equal to the user’s character level): At Will—light, 1/day—flare, produce flame.
Fourclaw Monstorin Racial Traits (13 RP)
Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Strength, +2 Charisma, –2 Dexterity, –4 Wisdom: Blood fiend monstorin are naturally intimidating, but lack sense and mobility.
Size: Medium. A blood fiend’s size gives no bonuses or penalties.
Speed: Blood fiends have a base speed of 30 feet.
Senses: Darkvision. A blood fiend gains darkvision out to 60 feet.
Type: Monstrous Humanoid. Blood fiends are monstrous humanoids.
Battlefield Adept (Sp): Once per day, a blood fiend can cast battlefield adept. Its caster level is equal to its character level.
Four-Armed (Ex): Blood fiends have 4 arms they can use to wield multiple weapons. When doing so, only one weapon is considered the blood fiend’s primary, while the others are all off-hand weapons. They can also use their extra hands for other purposes that require free hands.
Claws: Blood fiends have 2 natural claw attacks that deal 1d4 piercing and slashing damage on a hit.
Languages: Aklo. Blood fiends with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Abyssal, Common, Infernal, and Undercommon.
Geminel Monstorin Racial Traits (10 RP)
Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma: Geminel monstorin are quick, with a child-like demeanor.
Size: Medium. A geminel’s size gives no bonuses or penalties.
Speed: Slow. Arbiters have a base speed of 20 ft.
Limited Flight: A geminel can fly, but without magical aid or special training cannot lift itself more than 5 feet above solid ground. It can briefly push itself higher, which acts exactly as jumping. It takes no damage from falling (as if subject to a constant non-magical feather fall spell). While in midair, a geminel can move up to 5 feet in any horizontal direction for every 1 foot it falls, at a speed of 60 feet per round. It cannot gain height with its wings alone; it merely coasts in other directions as it falls. If subjected to a strong wind or any other effect that causes a creature with gliding wings to rise, it can take advantage of the updraft to increase the distance it can glide.
Senses: Darkvision. Geminels gain darkvision out to 60 ft.
Type: Outsider. Geminels are outsiders with the aie, native and water subtypes.
Storm-Born (Ex): Geminels gain electricity resistance 5. Any time a geminel takes electricity damage, it gains fast healing 2 for 1 round. It can only regain up to 2 hit points per level per day from this ability.
Languages: Common and Auran. Geminels with high Intelligence scores can choose any language (except secret languages, such as druidic).
Gremlin Racial Traits
Ability Score Modifiers: Gremlin monstorin are smart and surprisingly strong for their size. They gain +2 Strength, +2 Intelligence.
Size: Gremlins are Small creatures and gain a +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a –1 penalty to their CMB and CMD, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.
Type: Gremlin monstorin are humanoids with the monstorin subtype.
Fast Movement: Gremlins have a base speed of 30 ft.
Languages: Gremlins begin play speaking Common and undercommon. Gremlins with high Intelligence scores can choose can choose any languages they want (except secret languages, such as Druidic). See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.
Gremlin Heritage (Su): Each gremlin monstorin chooses up to two of the abilities presented here and gains access to them as described.

Gremlin Heritage

Gremlin Lice (Ex): The gremlin is infested with gremlin lice. Whenever a warmblooded creature comes in physical contact with the gremlin, there is a 25% chance it contracts gremlin lice. 1d4 rounds later, the creature begins to itch. The itch proves so distracting that for the duration of the infestation, the individual takes a –1 penalty on all concentration and initiative checks. Fortunately, these annoying parasites cannot live long on non-gremlins, and only survive for 24 hours. Submersion in water or exposure to
freezing temperatures also kills a gremlin lice infestation.
Kneecapper (Ex): The gremlin gains a +4 racial bonus on combat maneuver checks to trip an opponent.
Magic Bag (Su): The gremlin always carries a pouch with it. This pouch contains an extradimensional space and operates like a bag of holding (type I). The gremlin must keep the pouch in sight and on its person at all times. If this pouch is separated from the gremlin, all of its former contents are lost, and it becomes a normal bag that contains a number of coins equal to half the value of the gremlin’s lost possessions. There is a 50% chance the bag can fall off when the goblin is critically hit or reduced to 0 or fewer hit points. A gremlin that loses its pouch must create a new one, a process that takes 1d4 days, or suffer a –1 morale penalty to all attacks, saves, and skill checks until it begins doing so. Until the new pouch is finished, it remains a non-magical bag, only becoming a fully functional extradimensional space once completed.
Misplacement (Su): Any time the gremlin succeeds at a Sleight of Hand check against a creature, it also rearranges that creature’s possessions. The next time that creature attempts to produce a weapon or item, it finds its possessions misplaced or disarranged; retrieving a stored item or drawing a weapon then requires a standard action instead of a move action (unless the gremlin has stolen the item in question). After spending this standard action, the target takes mental inventory and is no longer affected by this ability.
Putrid Vomit (Ex): Every 1d4 rounds, the gremlin can spew a 30-foot line of vomit as a standard action. Treat this as a ranged touch attack with no range increment. Anyone struck must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC 10 + half the gremlin’s level + its Constitution modifier) or be nauseated for 1d4 rounds.
Speedy Sabotage (Su): When using the Disable Device skill, the gremlin treats all devices as being one category simpler for the purposes of determining how long it takes to use the skill.
Tinker (Sp): Once per day, the gremlin can gain the following effect. Its caster level is equal to its character level. The gremlin can choose Tinker more than once.

The gremlin can cast bungle.
At 3rd level, if two gremlins with this ability are within 10 feet of each other, they can use aid another to cast bestow curse as a full round action. At 11th level, they can cast major curse instead.
At 5th level, if three gremlins with this ability are within 20 feet of each other, they can use aid another to cast dispel magic. At 10th level, they can cast break enchantment instead.
Unluck Aura (Su): For one round per day, the gremlin can radiate an aura of unluck to a radius of 20 feet. Any creature in this area must roll two d20s whenever a situation calls for a d20 roll (such as an attack roll, a skill check, or a saving throw) and must use the lower of the two results generated. These rounds need not be consecutive. This is a mind-affecting effect that does not work on animals, other gremlins, or trollspawn. Any character who gains any sort of luck bonus is immune to the gremlin unluck aura.
Jinx Cat Racial Traits
Ability Score Modifiers: Jinx cats are agile and smart, but can be impulsive. They gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, and –2 Wisdom.
Size: Jinx cats are Medium creatures and thus receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
Type: Jinx cats are humanoids with the monstorin subtype.
Base Speed: Jinx cats have a base speed of 30 feet.
Languages: Jinx cats begin play speaking Common. Jinx cats with high Intelligence scores can choose can choose any languages they want (except secret languages, such as Druidic). See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

Defense Racial Traits

Lucky: Jinx cats receive a +1 racial bonus on all saving throws.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

Magical: Jinx cats gain a +2 racial bonus to Spellcraft and Use Magic Device skill checks.

Senses Racial Traits

Darkvision: Jinx cats can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.
Low-Light Vision: Jinx cats can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

Offense Racial Traits

Fickle Fortune (Su): Once per day, as a standard action, a jinx cat can choose one ally or enemy within 30 feet of it. For one round, anytime that creature makes an ability check, attack roll, saving throw, or skill check, it rolls twice and takes the better result (if an ally) or the worse result (if an enemy). A Will saving throw (DC 10 + 1/2 the jinx cat’s level + its Intelligence modifier) negates this ability.
Lightning Cat Racial Traits
Ability Score Modifiers: Lightning cats are agile and likeable. They gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma.
Size: Lightning cats are Medium creatures and thus receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
Type: Lightning cats are humanoids with the monstorin subtype.
Fast Movement: Lightning cats have a base speed of 40 feet.
Languages: Lightning cats begin play speaking Common. Jinx cats with high Intelligence scores can choose can choose any languages they want (except secret languages, such as Druidic). See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

Defense Racial Traits

Storm in the Blood: Lightning cats gain fast healing 2 for 1 round anytime they take electricity damage. They can heal up to 2 hit points per level per day.

Offense Racial Traits

Lightning Born: Lightning cats are immune to light-based blindness and dazzle effects. They are treated as +1 level higher when casting light-based spells and spells with the electricity descriptor or using light-based or electricity-based class features. In addition, once per day as a swift action, lightning cats can deal +1d6 electricity damage with melee attacks. This lasts for up to 1 round per character level, and the lightning cat can end its effect as a free action.
Piskel Monstorin Racial Traits (12 RP)
Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma: Piskel monstorin are naturally graceful.
Size: Medium. A piskel’s size gives no bonuses or penalties.
Speed: A piskel has a base speed of 30 feet and a swim speed of 30 feet. This grants it a +8 racial bonus to Swim checks.
Jumper (Ex): Piskeli are always considered to have a running start when making Acrobatics checks to jump.
Senses: Darkvision. Piskel monstorin gain darkvision out to 60 ft.
Type: Outsider. Piskeli are outsiders with the native and water subtypes.
Acrobatic Swimmers: Piskeli always treat Acrobatics and Swim as class skills and can add Dexterity in place of Strength on all Swim checks.
Hold Breath: Piskel monstorin lack the monster’s ability to generate air naturally, but can still hold their breath for a number of rounds equal to four times their Constitution score before risking drowning or suffocating.
Languages: Common and Aquan. Piskeli with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Celestial, Draconic, Elven, Gnoll, Gnome, Goblin, Orc, and Sylvan.
Proginor Monstorin Racial Traits (12 RP)
Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Dexterity, +2 Wisdom, –2 Strength: Proginor monstorin are agile and perceptive, but not very strong.
Size: Medium. A proginor’s size gives no bonuses or penalties.
Speed: A proginor has a base fly speed of 30 feet, but cannot fly higher than 5-ft. off the ground at any time. It can still “jump” by propelling itself up or forward using Fly in place of Acrobatics.
Senses: Darkvision. Proginors gain darkvision out to 60 ft.
Type: Outsider. Proginors are outsiders with the air and native subtypes.
Resistances (Ex): Proginors gain acid resistance 5 and electricity resistance 5.
Skills (Ex): Proginors gain a +2 racial bonus on all Fly and Perception checks. Fly and Perception are always class skills for a proginor.
Languages: Common and Auran. Proginors with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Celestial, Draconic, Gnoll, Gnome, Goblin, Orc, and Sylvan.
Royciel Monstorin Racial Traits (12 RP)
Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Dexterity, +2 Wisdom: Royciel monstorin are agile and wise.
Size: Medium. A royciel’s size gives no bonuses or penalties.
Speed: Royciels have a base speed of 30 feet.
Senses: Darkvision. Royciels gain darkvision out to 60 feet.
Senses: Low-Light Vision. Royciels can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.
Type: Monstrous Humanoid. Royciels are monstrous humanoids.
Breath Weapon: Once per day, a royciel can breathe a 15-foot cone of freezing wind, dealing 1d6 points of cold damage to all creatures in the affected area. Those creatures can make a Reflex saving throw for half damage. The DC of the save is 10 + 1/2 the royciel’s character level + its Constitution modifier. At 5th level and every 5 levels thereafter, the royciel increases its breath weapon’s damage by 1d6 and can use its breath weapon 1 additional time per day, to a maximum of 6d6 cold damage 6/day at 20th level.
Skilled: A royciel always treats Sense Motive as a class skill and gains a +2 racial bonus to Sense Motive checks.
Languages: Common and Sylvan. Royciels with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Auran, Draconic, Elven, Gnome, Goblin, Halfling, and Sylvan.
Sagitor Monstorin Racial Traits (12 RP)
Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Dexterity, +2 Wisdom, –2 Charisma: Sagitor monstorin are natural rangers, with a penchant for living away from society and a working knowledge of the natural world.
Size: Medium. A sagitor ‘s size gives no bonuses or penalties.
Speed: Fast. Even without four legs, sagitor are quick on their feet. They have a base speed of 40 feet.
Senses: Low-Light Vision. Sagitor can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.
Type: Fey. Sagitor are fey.
Survival Instincts: Sagitor gain a +2 racial bonus to Perception and Survival.
Burning Bright (Sp): A creature that grapples a sagitor, or that hits it with an unarmed strike or natural attack, takes 1d6 points of fire damage. In addition, Sagitor can cast light at will as a supernatural ability.
Languages: Common and Ignan. Sagitors with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Draconic, Elven, Gnome, Goblin, Orc, Sylvan, and Undercommon.
Satyr Monstorin Racial Traits (10 RP)
Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Wisdom, +2 Charisma: Satyr monstorin are natural tricksters.
Size: Medium. A satyr’s size gives no bonuses or penalties.
Speed: Satyrs have a base speed of 30 feet.
Senses: Low-Light Vision. A satyr can see twice as far as a human in conditions of dim light.
Type: Fey. Satyrs are fey.
Natural Glamour (Sp): Each satyr can change its appearance at will to look like another humanoid creature. This ability functions like disguise self, except the duration is instantaneous and the satyr appears to be the exact same humanoid every time.
Survival Instincts: Satyrs gain a +2 racial bonus on all Perception and Survival checks.
Languages: Common and Sylvan. Satyrs with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Celestial, Draconic, Elven, Gnoll, Gnome, Goblin, and Orc.
Scamethyst Monstorin Racial Traits (11 RP)
Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Strength, +4 Dexterity, –2 Wisdom: Scamethyst monstorin are quick and strong, but short-sighted.
Size: Medium. A scamethyst’s size gives no bonuses or penalties.
Speed: Fast. Base speed of 40 feet.
Senses: Darkvision. Scamethysts gain 60-foot darkvision.
Type: Monstrous Humanoid. Scamethysts are monstrous humanoids with the earth and water subtypes.
Carapace: A scamethyst gains +3 natural armor, but its carapace makes it difficult to wear normal armor. The cost of armor for a scamethyst is doubled as if for a large creature.
Weakness: Scamethysts have vulnerability to sonic damage. A scamethyst that takes sonic damage loses its natural armor bonus for up to 24 hours. A lesser restoration spell can return the natural armor sooner.
Languages: Common and Terran. Scamethysts with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Aquan, Draconic, Giant, Gnome, Goblin, Orc, and Undercommon.
Taurinor Monstorin Racial Traits (11 RP)
Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Strength, +2 Constitution, –2 Dexterity: Strong and tough, taurinors lack mobility.
Size: Medium. A taurinor’s size gives no bonuses or penalties.
Speed: Slow. Taurinors have a base speed of 20 feet. They are never encumbered by armor or a heavy load.
Senses: Darkvision. Taurinors gain darkvision out to 60 ft. Monstrous Humanoid: Taurinors are monstrous humanoids.
Improved Overrun: Taurinors gain Improved Overrun as a bonus feat.
Gore: All taurinors gain a gore attack which deals 1d8 piercing damage.
Resistances: Taurinors have acid resistance 5 and a racial bonus on saving throws against poison effects equal to their Hit Dice.
Languages: Common and Terran. Taurinors with high intelligence can choose any language (except secret languages).
Vargouille Monstorin Racial Traits (11 RP)
Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Dexterity, –4 Strength, –2 Constitution: Vargouille monstorin are victims of the monsters whose transformation was stalled but never cured.
Size: Medium. A vargouille’s size gives no bonuses or penalties.
Speed: Vargouilles have a base speed of 30 feet.
Senses: Darkvision. Vargouilles gain darkvision out to 60 feet.
Type: Outsider. Vargouilles are outsiders with the native subtype.
Bite: Vargouilles gain a natural bite attack that deals 1d6 bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
Damage Reduction: Vargouilles have DR 5/good or silver.
Shriek (Su): Once per day, a vargouille can shriek, which functions as the special ability presented here, except a target that fails its save (Fortitude DC 10 + 1/2 the vargouille’s character level + its Constitution modifier) is only staggered for 2 rounds or until the vargouille attacks it.
Languages: Common and Aklo. Vargouilles with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Abyssal, Auran, Draconic, Elven, Infernal, Sylvan, and Undercommon.
Viriga Monstorin Racial Traits (13 RP)
Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Constitution, +2 Wisdom: Viriga monstorin are tough and insightful.
Size: Medium. A viriga’s size gives no bonuses or penalties.
Speed: Slow. Virigas have a base speed of 20 feet. They are never encumbered by armor or heavy loads.
Senses: Darkvision. A viriga gains darkvision out to 60 feet.
Special Sense: TremorsenseVirigas have tremorsense out to 30 feet.
Type: Outsider. Virigas are outsiders with the earth and native subtypes.
Barkskin (Sp): Once per day, a viriga can cast barkskin, as the spell. The viriga’s caster level is equal to its character level.
Skills: A viriga always treats Knowledge (nature) and Knowledge (planes) as class skills and gains a +2 racial bonus to each.
Languages: Common and Terran. Viriga with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Giant, Gnome, Goblin, Orc, Terran, and Undercommon.
Xendaug Monstorin Racial Traits (12 RP)
Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Strength, +2 Constitution, –2 Wisdom: Xendaug monstorin are powerful and animalistic.
Size: Medium. A xendaug’s size gives no bonuses or penalties.
Speed: Xendaugs have a base speed of 30 feet
Bonus Feat: Run. Xendaugs gain Run as a bonus feat at 1st level.
Senses: Low-Light Vision. A xendaug can see twice as far as a human in conditions of dim light.
Scent: Xendaugs have scent out the 30 feet.
Type: Humanoid. A xendaug is a humanoid with the animal, augmented, and monstorin subtypes.
Dispel Magic (Sp): Once per day, a xendaug can use dispel magic as a spell-like ability, but only to dispel enchantments and transmutations. The xendaug’s caster level is equal to its character level. The target must be able to hear the xendaug for the spell to take effect.
Polymorph Immunity: Xendaugs are immune to polymorph effects.
Skills: Xendaugs gain a +2 racial bonus to Perception checks involving scent.
Languages: Common. Xendaugs with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Aquan, Auran, Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, Goblin, Ignan, Terran, and Xendauni.
Zari Elephant Monstorin Racial Traits (12 RP)
Ability Score Modifiers: +4 Strength, +2 Intelligence, +2 Wisdom, +2 Charisma, –2 Dexterity: Quick-thinking and incredibly strong, a zari’s beautiful, elephantine form makes it less agile than most monsters.
Type: Humanoid. Zari elephants are humanoids with the air and monstorin subtypes.
Multiple Heads (Ex): Zari have two heads, granting them a +2 racial bonus to Perception checks and a +2 racial bonus to Will saving throws against mind-affecting effects.
Meditative: Zari that utilize burn (nonlethal damage the fuels some psychic powers) increase their burn limit by +1 per round and treat their Constitution as 2 points higher when determining the total number of burn points they can accept each day. Alternatively, a zari may spend 5 minutes in meditation once per day. At the end of that time, the zari regains one daily use of a spell-like, supernatural, or extraordinary ability normally limited by uses per day.
